instrument_type_details.notes: UAL consolidated (United + Continental merged Oct 1, 2010): 35% of 2011 expected fuel consumption hedged with maximum price protection. 20% also has minimum price protection (swaps/collars). Breakdown: heating oil swaps 9% ($2.22/gal), heating oil calls 9% ($2.23/gal), WTI crude swaps 9% ($2.02/gal), WTI crude calls 6% ($2.24/gal), WTI crude collars 2% ($2.29/gal max, $1.57/gal min). UAL hedge approx 60% of Q1 2011 expected consumption with decreasing coverage rest of year. United subsidiary: 37% hedged; Continental subsidiary: 28% hedged. Prices in $/gallon (heating oil equivalent to jet fuel).

warnings: UAL merged with Continental Airlines on October 1, 2010, forming United Continental Holdings Inc. - this is the first combined filing
Ticker changed from UAUA to UAL upon merger completion
Company name changed to United Continental Holdings, Inc. (renamed United Airlines Holdings in 2019)
UAL fair value $375M includes both United ($277M) and Continental ($98M) subsidiaries
35% is the combined UAL consolidated hedge ratio; United standalone is 37%, Continental standalone is 28%
Impact of $1/bbl increase in fuel price on annual expense: UAL -$99M, United -$57M, Continental -$42M (2011 projections)

throughput.source_quote: Total fuel consumption (gallons): 4,072 (2010, combined United+Continental, from FY2011 10-K comparative table; the FY2010 10-K itself shows 2,388M for United-only legacy operations)
